name: Cartspring – Abandoned Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: theplugins101

sections.description:
Cartspring helps WooCommerce stores follow up with shoppers who leave items in their carts. Set a reminder schedule, send helpful emails through WooCommerce, and give shoppers a secure link to restore their cart.

Cartspring captures carts for logged-in customers and guests. Guest email addresses are captured at checkout when available. You can configure up to three reminder emails, edit their content, and optionally include a unique, single-use coupon in the final enabled reminder.

Cart and subscriber records are stored in your site’s WordPress database. Cartspring does not connect to an external cart-recovery service. Reminder emails are sent through the WooCommerce mailer and your site’s configured email delivery.

Features

  • Capture carts for logged-in customers and guests, including guest email capture at checkout.
  • Schedule up to three WooCommerce reminder emails with configurable delays and send times.
  • Restore a saved cart with a secure, one-click link.
  • Optionally add a customer-specific, single-use coupon to the final enabled reminder.
  • Edit each reminder’s subject, heading, message, and email format; preview changes and send test emails.
  • Add an opt-out notice at checkout and provide unsubscribe links and an email preferences page.
  • Review carts, sent reminders, recovered orders, and recovery activity in the WooCommerce admin.
  • Send a reminder right away or act on many carts at once: send, mark as recovered, unsubscribe, or delete.
  • Get store emails about abandoned carts (one per cart or a daily digest) and about carts recovered by a reminder.
  • Exclude carts by email address or domain, IP address, country, or user role.
  • Give guests a different wait before the first reminder, and set a reply-to address for reminder emails.
  • Use Cartspring with the WooCommerce Checkout Block and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Requires WooCommerce 9.0 or later. Requires WordPress 6.6 or later and PHP 8.1 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload Cartspring to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate Cartspring through the Plugins screen.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Cartspring – Abandoned Cart Recovery → Settings and enable cart reminders.
  5. Choose the reminder count and schedule. Optionally select a coupon template for the final enabled reminder.
  6. Edit the reminder emails under Reminder schedule if needed.
sections.faq:
How many reminder emails can I send?

You can enable up to three reminders and configure their delays and send times.

How does Cartspring capture guest carts?

Cartspring can capture a guest’s email from the checkout email field or from the billing email on the WooCommerce session. A guest cart without an email address cannot receive a reminder.

Can I offer a discount?

Yes. Select a WooCommerce coupon as a template. Cartspring can create a unique, single-use coupon for the customer and include it in the final enabled reminder. Earlier reminders do not include the coupon by default.

How does cart restoration work?

The reminder includes a secure link that rebuilds the saved cart in the shopper’s browser. Cartspring does not automatically log the shopper into an account.

Can shoppers opt out of reminders?

Yes. You can show an opt-out checkbox at checkout. Reminder emails also include an unsubscribe link, and shoppers can manage their email preference on the preferences page.

Where do I configure Cartspring?

Go to WooCommerce → Cartspring – Abandoned Cart Recovery → Settings. The reminder email editor is available from the Reminder schedule section.

Does Cartspring use an external recovery service?

No. Cart records are stored in your site’s WordPress database. Emails are sent through the WooCommerce mailer using the email delivery configured for your site.

Is Cartspring compatible with the WooCommerce Checkout Block and HPOS?

Yes. Cartspring declares compatibility with the WooCommerce Checkout Block and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Store notification emails. “Abandoned cart” tells you when a shopper leaves a cart behind, either one email per cart or a single daily digest at an hour you choose (off by default). “Recovered cart” tells you when a reminder turns into an order (on by default).
  • New: Exclusions. Skip carts by email address or domain, IP address or range, country (billing or geolocated) or user role. Excluded carts are not saved and never get reminders.
  • New: Send a reminder now. Send any reminder email straight from the Abandoned carts list, one cart at a time or in bulk.
  • New: Bulk actions on the Abandoned carts list: mark as recovered, unsubscribe the customer, or delete.
  • New: Separate wait before the first email for guest shoppers, so guests and logged-in customers can be reminded on different schedules.
  • New: Reply-to address for reminder emails, so customer replies reach the right inbox.
  • New: Developer hooks to decide which carts are tracked and which reminders are sent, to set the visitor’s country, to add your own bulk actions and to run code when a reminded cart is ordered.
  • Improved: Cartspring can now be translated on translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
